reason: The need is real, my son wanders and I lie awake over it. But a camera strapped to him feels like surveillance of someone who can't consent, and I don't know this company or anyone who has used it. I'd want to read real reviews from families in the support groups before I put $249 and a monthly plan on it.
objection: A camera on my non-verbal son feels like surveillance, and I don't know what happens to the footage or who can see the view log. Is this a company I can trust with his dignity?
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews from parents of wandering kids in the Facebook and Reddit groups saying it connected when it mattered and the camera stayed off as promised, plus a clear written statement on who can view the footage.
